card.hint: Make a wish first. Sound on 🔊
card.wished: Your wish is on its way ✨

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Cards are kept for five days and then deleted. Making a new one takes a minute.

bot.start: 🎂 A birthday card A few questions and I will hand you a link. Send it to the birthday person. The link lives for 5 days.
bot.ask_lang: Which language should the card be in?
bot.ask_name: Who are we celebrating? Type their name.
bot.ask_age: How old are they turning? Numbers only, or /skip
bot.ask_field: What do they do? It decides which number the card shows.
bot.ask_brief: Now tell me about them — what they are like, what they love, what the two of you remember, anything you want to say. One message. The more specific it is, the better the letter.
bot.ask_letter: Write the letter. It goes onto the card exactly as you type it.
bot.ask_from: Who is it from? Type your name or /skip
bot.working: ✍️ Writing the letter… this can take half a minute
bot.done: ✅ Done. Copy the link and send it:
bot.bad_name: Please type a name (at least 2 letters).
bot.bad_text: That is very short. Give me a little more.
bot.ai_failed: The model did not answer just now. Would you like to write it yourself?
bot.failed: Something went wrong and the card was not saved. Start again: /start
bot.limit_user: Daily limit reached — {limit} cards a day. Try again tomorrow.
bot.limit_global: The service hit its daily cap. Try again tomorrow.

fact_notes.perfect: A perfect number — equal to the sum of its own divisors. There are only two below a hundred.
fact_notes.factorial: Every number from one to {k}, multiplied. A tidy figure.
fact_notes.primorial: The product of the first {k} primes. Not every age can say that.
fact_notes.square_triangular: Square and triangular at once. The next one is 1225.
fact_notes.power2: A power of two. Computers are fond of these.
fact_notes.cube: A perfect cube. There are only four below a hundred.
fact_notes.square: A perfect square — an age with no rough edges.
fact_notes.fibonacci: A Fibonacci number: the sum of the two before it. This is the sequence things grow along.
fact_notes.triangular: A triangular number — a pyramid {k} rows deep comes to exactly this.
fact_notes.repdigit: Twice the same digit. That happens once in a life, not once a year.
fact_notes.prime: A prime number. It divides by itself and one, and by nothing else.
fact_notes.round: A round number. These are the years people remember.
fact_notes.code: Binary and hexadecimal. Your trade speaks in both.
fact_notes.heart: That is roughly how many times your heart has beaten. Without being asked once.
fact_notes.words: About that many words spoken. A few of them stuck.
fact_notes.orbit: {n} laps around the sun. Without leaving the room.
fact_notes.seasons: That many springs. No two of them alike.
fact_notes.sleep: Roughly that many years asleep. No regrets there.

landing.title: A birthday card
landing.lede: Answer a few questions in the Telegram bot and get a link. Send it to the birthday person: they blow out the candles, the melody plays, the letter opens.
landing.how: Every link lives for five days, then deletes itself.
